method.name: Gaussian copula with inverse-CDF marginal transforms and post-sampling finite-bound rejection
method.random_generator: NumPy PCG64 (64-bit); one seeded Generator drives all draws
method.random_draw_order: correlated standard-normal 4-vectors in driver-config order, then marginal transforms
method.batch_size: exactly the remaining valid paths per iteration; no surplus accepted paths
method.rejection: Nonfinite or outside inclusive driver bounds is rejected and replaced; n_rejected counts every excluded candidate draw
method.valuation: Five full fiscal years; constant growth and margin within a path; FY5 Gordon terminal FCFF; actual-date discount periods
method.formula: FCFF=EBIT*(1-tax)-reinvestment; TV=FCFF_FY5*(1+g)/(r-g); per-share=(PV(FCFF)+PV(TV)+cash+ST investments-net debt)/diluted shares

reinvestment_intensity.unit: decimal net reinvestment / revenue; positive uses cash

dependence.parameter_meaning: Pearson correlations of latent standard normals, before nonlinear marginal transforms; realized driver correlations are separately reported
dependence.rationale: 0.35 latent growth-margin correlation represents shared demand/scale benefits despite AI depreciation; zero cross-correlations are simplifying assumptions, not proof of independence

realized_correlation.method: Pearson sample correlation on accepted realized driver values

equity_bridge.unit: USD millions and diluted shares millions

percentile_convention.name: linear
percentile_convention.formula: Sort N values; position=(N-1)*q, zero-based; linearly interpolate between floor and ceiling ranks

limitations: Conditional DCF distribution, not a stock-price forecast, trading range, probability of return or market consensus
Frozen inputs contain consolidated financials only; cloud demand, data-center capacity/utilization and commitment-duration effects are unobserved scenario assumptions
Four observations of annual growth cannot identify a reliable dependence structure; copula correlations are judgmental and nonlinear transforms alter realized correlations
Growth and EBIT margin are constant within each path, unlike the fading-growth deterministic model; no within-path mean reversion, cyclicality or parameter learning
Reinvestment is an independent revenue-scaled net amount, not a pathwise roll-forward of PP&E, depreciation lives, capacity utilization or working-capital accounts; SBC remains an operating cost
Tax, terminal growth, net debt, cash and diluted shares are fixed; no financing feedback, buybacks, dilution, acquisitions, tax changes or joint tail dependence
Triangular support and truncated lognormal bounds are judgmental stress limits informed by historical volatility; they are not calibrated probabilities of future outcomes
